compatibility.instructions: Could the capture-traversal module, its test file, or the CI lens-list addition regress any existing lens contract, capture-scope inventory shape, budget semantic, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any wrong outcome mapping (completed/partial/failed), dropped page without a failed/skipped record, out-of-order attempt, wrong budget accounting, unenforced byte/time exhaustion, unmapped fetch rejection, trusted malformed fetch record, or test/implementation mismatch (including maxDepth 0 handling)?

evidence.instructions: Are the 10 unit tests sufficient for all-captured order, single failure partial, all-fail failed, per-page budget pass-through, byte exhaustion skip, time exhaustion skip, untyped rejection mapping, malformed fetch records, malformed inventories, and single-page execution?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic ordering, concurrent attempt, unhandled rejection shape, elapsed-time instability across equivalent inputs, or scope-hash mismatch?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond sequential scope execution and inventory reporting: retries, browser capture, network transport, storage, job lifecycle, or public API?

security.instructions: Any SSRF bypass (fetch outside the injected function), cross-scope page execution, silent over-budget attempt, fabricated page content, or secret/credential material in the module or tests?
